title: dev-05: Model — Metadata
description: Implement the Metadata struct in Metadata.swift. Metadata stores key-value string pairs and exposes a subscript(key: String) -> String?, computed properties servings: [Int]?, title: String?, tags: [String], and allEntries: [(key: String, value: String)]. Add Sendable and Equatable conformances.
acceptance_criteria: public struct Metadata: Sendable, Equatable is declared with the required subscript and computed properties.
servings returns parsed integers from the canonical 'servings' key (comma/whitespace-separated).
title returns the value for the canonical 'title' key.
tags returns a parsed list from the canonical 'tags' key.
allEntries returns all stored key-value pairs in insertion order.
